top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 212 RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 7 were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The FEC filings API returned 108 RFAI letters (form type FRQ) and 104 Form 99 filings received October 7 through October 10. Each one had already appeared in a prior edition, so none is repeated here.

The overnight screen of filing text for fraud-related keywords turned up only two filings, both of which were already surfaced in earlier editions. The pre-pass found no voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more.

footer.coverage_window: FEC filings received October 7, 2026 through the morning of October 10, 2026 (Pacific time), minus filings reported in earlier editions.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
footer.known_gaps: The NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day request returned no data, so it is omitted. One Money Out query (Trump National) timed out at the FEC with an HTTP 504.
